transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount in the RollCall system to protect student data from unauthorized access and ensure accurate attendance records. Requiring encryption of data (TRU-01), role-based access control (TRU-02), and comprehensive audit logs (TRU-03) safeguard against breaches and maintain integrity. Students must authenticate to view their records (TRU-04) and the data integrity must be verifiable (TRU-05). Reporting mechanisms (TRU-06) also enhance accountability, while session timeouts (TRU-07) protect against unauthorized access during inactivity.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is critical for the RollCall system. Implementing energy-efficient algorithms (GRN-01) and supporting cloud storage that prioritizes energy efficiency (GRN-02) will minimize the carbon footprint. Using low-energy communication protocols for real-time updates (GRN-03) and generating reports in eco-friendly formats (GRN-04) further reduces resource consumption. Notifying users of their carbon footprint (GRN-05) encourages responsible behavior. Aligning data retention policies with sustainable practices (GRN-06) and optimizing the user interface for low-power devices (GRN-07) ensures the system is environmentally friendly. These requirements collectively promote sustainability without compromising performance or functionality.

transcript.statement: Ethical and compliance considerations are essential for the RollCall system. Ensuring compliance with data protection regulations (RES-01) safeguards student privacy. Logging attendance changes (RES-02) promotes accountability, while a formal dispute process (RES-03) supports fairness for students. Anonymizing attendance reports (RES-04) protects identities, and timely notifications (RES-05) keep students informed. Restricting access to authorized personnel (RES-06) enhances security, and maintaining historical data for regulatory compliance (RES-07) is vital for long-term accountability. These requirements collectively ensure that the system operates ethically and responsibly.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is crucial for the RollCall system to ensure a seamless user experience. Real-time data processing (EFF-01) is essential for timely updates, while supporting 500 concurrent users (EFF-02) prevents performance degradation. Quick report generation (EFF-03) keeps administrators informed, and allowing students to view records swiftly (EFF-05) enhances user satisfaction. Load balancing (EFF-06) optimizes resource use across classes, while a responsive user interface (EFF-07) is critical for user interactions. These requirements collectively ensure that the system can handle demands effectively without sacrificing performance.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication and encryption of user data to protect attendance records.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles, ensuring accountability.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and processing to ensure timely updates of attendance records.
The system shall generate attendance reports efficiently while maintaining anonymity for student identities.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years.
The system shall provide a logging mechanism for all attendance modifications to support accountability and traceability.
The system shall support cloud storage solutions that prioritize energy-efficient data centers.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations using efficient algorithms.
The system shall notify users of their attendance status via email or app notification.
